comment: ANCHOR: CIO_PROSPECT_WRITER_20261023 — AGENTS.md §26; CIO_PROSPECT_DATA_FOUNDATION.md §11 backlog item 2 (task
T-20261023-e95684): the curator and the entry-state runner call scripts/lib/cio_prospect_writer.py, which builds
with cio_prospect_builder and calls InstrumentRecordStore.upsert_prospect only when
TRADEAI_CIO_PROSPECT_PG_DUAL_WRITE=1 (OFF: shadow artifact + receipt only). Idempotent, conflicts recorded never
resolved, fail-soft on any DB error, MBI_BEHAVIOR = 0 (behavior keys refuse the row). Postgres proof on a
throwaway initdb cluster (unix socket only, never production; skipped without server binaries or psycopg2).
